input.prompt: A single seamless tileable GREYSCALE roughness variation study for brushed brass, an orthographic square covering exactly 0.20 metre across. This is a data-like material study, not a lit photograph: mid-grey field with restrained fine horizontal directional brushing and very light irregular patina. Black corresponds to low roughness and white to high roughness, but keep values in a narrow medium-grey range. Both opposite edge pairs join continuously in an infinite repeated grid; horizontal brushing must wrap left/right and patina must wrap top/bottom. No colour, no metallic reflections, no specular highlights, no directional illumination, no baked shadows, no fixtures, no writing, no symbols, no border, no vignette. Uniformly detailed full-frame square, intended for a final 512x512 roughness candidate; not a physically measured map.
